limitations.text: No usable, exact historical glyph image URL with inspected character-specific identity and provenance was established. Xiaoxuetang’s query interface and CC0 notice were inspected, but no 汽-specific record could be retrieved; Commons search likewise did not yield an inspected exact description page. The Shuowen small-seal form is recorded by the MOE dictionary, but its glyph pixels were not inspected and no image URL is proposed.
